name: proto-blocks/oit-call-to-action
title: OIT Call to Action
description: Headline + body intro paragraph paired with an outline CTA button. Anchors a section before content (cards, grids, etc.) or stands alone as a callout.

solidButton.label: Solid red button
solidButton.help: Off: outlined pill (black text, red border, fills on hover). On: filled red pill with white text.

ctaDesktopOnly.label: Hide button on mobile
ctaDesktopOnly.help: Hides the CTA below the desktop breakpoint. Pair with the mobile-only Bottom CTA on the cards block that follows, so the button appears after the card list on mobile instead.
